card.name: Inside drug and enzyme names in interactions
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug name or CYP enzyme name (e.g. criz-ot-inib, CYP3A, P450) in drug interaction sections, just before more of the name follows.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a drug name that is being split into parts, in an interaction sentence.
modes.example: increase plasma concentrations of criz<<ot>>inib. Use caution with concom

modes.label: Inside CYP enzyme names
modes.description: The digit within CYP3A or P450 before the rest of the enzyme name.

modes.label: Linking words in interaction statements
modes.description: Short word or word start in phrases about concomitant use or interactions.
modes.example: If<< con>>comitant use of a UGT1

card.writes: Little visible effect on the output; the promoted tokens are Chinese and English words for 'such as' and 'many'.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of drug or enzyme names in sections about drug interactions.
